name: steady
description: Local macOS drawing companion — phase 03 Krita integration

scripts.test:native: npm run build:native && CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/private/tmp/steady-native-module-cache SWIFTPM_MODULECACHE_OVERRIDE=/private/tmp/steady-native-module-cache swift test --package-path native --arch arm64 --scratch-path .cache/swift-test-xcode --cache-path .cache/swiftpm --disable-sandbox -Xswiftc -load-plugin-library -Xswiftc /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/lib/swift/host/plugins/testing/libTestingMacros.dylib && python3 native/Tests/integration.py resources/bin/SteadyNative
scripts.package: npm run build:native && npm run verify:assets && electron-forge package --arch=arm64 --platform=darwin
scripts.make: npm run build:native && npm run verify:assets && electron-forge make --arch=arm64 --platform=darwin
